decisions.reason: This product survived the early post-launch shakeout, fits closely with a large German metal-products firm's core industrial door business, and under escalation of commitment management is likely to continue backing it while weak recent visibility can be attributed to temporary factors.

As an insulated industrial door variant, it is central to the firm's established capabilities and likely benefited from meaningful development and marketing investment, which makes management inclined to retain it rather than reverse course.

Because it had its own dedicated webpage and remained presented after launch, the firm's public commitment appears strongest here, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within the next year relatively unlikely.
